devices.title: Shelly Devices
devices.description: Discovered and manually added Shelly devices.
devices.empty: No devices yet. Run discovery, or add your first Shelly by its IP.
devices.deleteDescription: Remove {{name}} ({{address}}) from the registry? The device itself is not changed.

add.title: Add a device
add.description: Enter the device's IP address. We probe GET /shelly to detect its generation and model.
add.name: Name (optional)

password.title: Admin password
password.description: Set or change the admin password of {{name}} ({{address}}).
password.currentDescription: Required because this device already has authentication enabled.
password.newDescription: Protects the device's local web interface and API.

discovery.title: Discover devices
discovery.description: Listens for Shelly devices announcing over mDNS, then probes every address of a subnet. Everything found is added to the registry.
discovery.subnetDescription: Leave empty to scan the server's own networks. Private ranges only, /22 at most. Required when Attraccess runs in a container, since its network is not your LAN.
discovery.running: Probing addresses — a /24 takes a few seconds.
discovery.hint: Nothing answered GET /shelly. If Attraccess runs in a container, enter the subnet your devices are on — the container's own network is not your LAN.

info.title: Device info
info.auth: This device requires authentication. Enter its admin password to read protected info.
info.name: Name

firmware.description: Check for and install firmware updates on {{name}} ({{address}}).
firmware.installing: Installing the {{stage}} firmware{{version}}. The device reboots during the update and is offline for a moment — this page keeps checking.
firmware.timeout: The device did not report the expected firmware version within 5 minutes. Check it and re-check the firmware manually.
